visualCharacteristics:
rc8: Two source sections merged into one white band. Centered gradient H2, then the gradient-pill accordion. New project block, named accordion as directed: gradient pill headers, first item open, Explore button in the panel. The FAQ list is its faq option.
rc18: Two source sections merged into one white band. Centered gradient H2, then plain FAQ rows. faq option of the new accordion block: plain rows with thin dividers and chevrons instead of gradient pills; Show more clamps long answers in the browser.

cells: Content: optional subheading, paragraphs, optional link

contentPattern.authoring: One row per item: cell 1 title; cell 2 content (optional subheading, paragraphs, optional link). Default: gradient pill headers. faq option: plain rows with dividers and chevrons.

usage.description: Expandable items built on native details/summary; first item open.

reuseGuidance: Use for capability lists or FAQs that should collapse. Use the faq option for question/answer lists.
